hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const e=JSON.parse(d),p=((e.tool_input||{}).file_path||'').split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');if(p.includes('src/components/slides/')&&p.endsWith('.jsx'))console.log('🎨 슬라이드 컴포넌트 변경 — design-reviewer 검증 권장')}catch(_){}})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const e=JSON.parse(d);if((e.prompt||'').includes('lecture.md'))console.log('⚠️ 강사 자료(lecture.md)는 절대 수정하지 않습니다')}catch(_){}})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const e=JSON.parse(d),p=((e.tool_input||{}).file_path||'').split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');const inLectures=p.includes('/lectures/')||p.startsWith('lectures/');const isInstructor=p.endsWith('/lecture.md')||p.endsWith('/assignment.md')||p.endsWith('/checklist.md');if(inLectures&&isInstructor)console.log('⛔ lecture.md/assignment.md/checklist.md는 강사 영역. 수정 금지.')}catch(_){}})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const e=JSON.parse(d),p=((e.tool_input||{}).file_path||'').split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');if(p.startsWith('reference/')||p.includes('/reference/'))console.log('⛔ reference/ 폴더는 검증된 데모. 수정 금지.')}catch(_){}})"
